title: Stop chasing unpaid invoices by hand
summary: In 90 minutes you build an n8n workflow that emails polite reminders about overdue invoices and stops the moment the client pays.
directory_line: Build reminders that go out on schedule and stop the moment a client pays.
description: Sample webinar used by the test suite.
audience: Freelancers and small business owners who invoice clients
leave_with: A reminder workflow running in your own n8n account, not a copy of someone else's screen.
A schedule you can change: reminders at 3, 7 and 14 days overdue.
A check that stops reminders once an invoice is marked paid, so nobody who has paid gets chased.
The exported workflow file, ready to reuse for your next client.
